video.description:
Learn to explain testing code with fake objects: Unit Test, Test Double & Mock Object, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Unit Test - A small automatic check that proves one piece of code works.
Test Double - A fake object that stands in for a real one during a test.
Mock Object - A fake object that also records how it was used, so a test can check the calls.

landscape.description:
Explain Unit Test, Test Double & Mock Object in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Unit Test, Test Double, Mock Object 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Unit Test - A small automatic check that proves one piece of code works.
한국어: Unit Test: 코드 한 조각이 제대로 동작하는지 증명하는 작은 자동 검사

Test Double - A fake object that stands in for a real one during a test.
한국어: Test Double: 테스트 동안 진짜 객체를 대신하는 가짜 객체

Mock Object - A fake object that also records how it was used, so a test can check the calls.
한국어: Mock Object: 사용된 방식을 기록해서 테스트가 호출을 확인할 수 있게 하는 가짜 객체

landscape.hook: Can you explain Unit Test, Test Double and Mock Object in English?

dialogue.title: No real emails

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want a unit test for signup, but it sends a real email.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A unit test checks one small piece of code. It must not use the real network.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So what do I use instead of the real mailer?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A test double. It stands in for the real object during the test.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, it is a mock object. It also records every call in `sent`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the unit test can check `sent` after signup?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Pass the mock object into the signup code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if I only need a fixed answer, not a record?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then a simple test double is enough. You do not need a mock object.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. One unit test, one test double.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And keep each unit test fast, under a second.
I wrote a unit test for the price calculator.
